column1: # WeAct MiniSTM32H743 header pinout, recovered from Hardware/STM32H7xx CoreBoard AltiumDesigner.IntLib (github.com/WeActStudio/MiniSTM32H7xx) by zlib-decompressing the OLE streams and parsing the length-prefixed pin name/designator records. Cross-checked against Hardware/STM32H7xx SchDoc V12.pdf. 92 header positions; 74 GPIO exposed. The ONLY port pins not on a header are PC13 (user button K1) and PE3 (user LED) - which the schematic independently confirms, so the two sources agree. PA13/PA14 are SWDIO/SWCLK on the separate 5-pin SWD header. Designators 3, 7, 10, 90 and 91 did not parse and are almost certainly power/GND - VERIFY those five against the schematic. Dual-row headers: designators pair up (11/12, 13/14, ...), one row odd and one even.
